notes.title: Update v0.2.0 - Cosmic Knights
notes.content:
[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395989/47ccc2f0dd660eaf39547bc10a56037228a9f8d6.png[/img]

A new content meteor is incoming! Or should I say... a comet of content is crashing and making landfall? (I'm glad I never started as a comedian gumball.) Nevertheless, please find the newest additions for v0.2.0, alongside bug fixes!

[b]Note:[/b] v0.2.1 has been deployed with a minor fix: you can now get the Knights of the Round Table through using Gumball Jars.

[h2]v0.2.0 Patchnotes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The addition of the Land of Comet Crash, alongside the two Gumballs within - Astral Lord and Astral Explorer!
[*] The addition of the Knights of the Round Table (Gaheris, Lancelot, Lamorak, Galahad, Gawaine, and of course, King Arthur), who can all be found utilising Hunting Certificates.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ultra Player Gumball, that they weren't getting the simulation bonus when using the Space Wizard's Space Door skill and gathering gems
[*] Fixed an issue in the Promised Land of Forging, where removing the Soul Armor would make an enemy disappear and not count as a kill
[*] Fixed an issue in the Promised Land of Forging, where monsters would have 0HP and Flame Dragon Blades would be abnormally displayed on the map
[*] Fixed an issue with Hell Frontier, where there was a specific set of actions that could grant Golden Pots
[*] Fixed an issue with District 91, where there also was a specific set of actions that would lead to Golden Pots being granted
[*] Fixed an issue where two arenas would appear on the 75th floor of Ancient Arena 
[*] Fixed an issue where Pan Gu Gumball could use an arcane potion after using a skill, then the skill could be recast multiple times on the same level of the maze
[*] Fixed an issue where Demonic/Mechanical Titles just disappear in the Next Millennium Maze
[*] Adjusted the mechanism of obtaining the dragon balls for the Ultra Player Gumball to become more consistent on every fourth floor. You can no longer return to a floor to retrieve a pre-existing Dragon Ball.
[/olist]

[url=https://discord.gg/XbypJbQfxK]Excited and want to talk about the new additions, well, come join our friendly Discord community![/url]

Safe adventures,
Kevin and the Gumballs team

notes.title: Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395989/1a8010aa866b89a79334c692520db80b88bf0520.gif[/img]

Have you remembered to take care and feed yourself well? Remember, a healthy body leads to being a healthy Gumball!

[h2]v0.1.2 Patchnotes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain situations the Ultra Player Gumball, when using the "I want to be Strong!" Divine Dragon wish, would get teleported into a floor with no exit or boss
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could lock the game twice with the Ultra Player Gumball instead of just once through unintended mechanics
[*] Fixed an issue where the Divine Dragon Wish icon was obscured by the special magic tab, so you'd have to click twice. Now, you just have to click once
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ultra Player Gumball when acquiring the Gumball and turning off their passive talent. After saving and exiting the game, the talent will be turned off, but any Gumballs entering the maze will still erroneously carry the [Game Strategy] book when entering the maze.
[*] Resolved an issue in the Dragon Valley maze, where if the Ultra Player Gumball casted Annihilation, it wouldn't kill the enemy (the only thing it would annihilate is your own hopes and dreams)
[*] Resolved an error that occurred when using the God of Thieves title within the Temple of Mars, where using the Warming Bonfire to backtrack would cause the game to become stuck in loading instead.
[*] Resolved an error where there could be a data issue when playing through the Legend of the Dragon Event Maze.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Gods' Chessboard Maze, when attempting to acquire the Checkers Gumball, summons would get stuck in certain levels and not attack monsters correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where players received the wrong amount of gems from the Divine Dragon Wish event. 
[*] Resolved an audio issue where the Next Millennium wouldn't follow the adjusted volume in settings correctly.
[/olist]

[url=https://discord.gg/XbypJbQfxK]As always, our community Discord server is open 24/7 if you need to directly contact us![/url]

Safe adventures,
Kevin and the Gumballs team

- Fixed an issue in the Gods' Chessboard Maze, when attempting to acquire the Checkers Gumball, summons would get stuck in certain levels and not attack monsters correctly

notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395989/121e1976ea259f096f978d66bf654ca1fefa417f.gif[/img]

Some more user experience changes that we're tweaking thanks to player feedback, alongside some more little issues that just needed a lil bit of Gumball magic to fix!

[h2]v0.1.1 Patchnotes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted automatic pickup functionality further. You can now adjust in the System Settings to three different settings: For it to be disabled, for it to activate on every tile, or for it to activate on "Perfect Kill" only.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Red Dragon Gumball couldn't be acquired from the Gumball Jars
[*] Fixed an issue where the Drunkard's Passive Ability in the Hero's Village wasn't affect their allies (aka YOUR enemies just became stronger!)
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple damaged magic arrays could appear in Bracada College
[*] Fixed an issue where stores would continually refresh items after loading from a save file
[*] Fixed an issue where in the Hell Frontier's Paradise Lost, the Dark Crystal Core would always be the "Immune to Spell Forbidden" even on maximum level
[*] Fixed an issue in the Promised Land of Forging, where godhood points gained from killing monsters on the same floor was not recovered after loading a saved game
[*] Fixed an issue in the Lost Temple, where signposts pointing to lower levels disappeared when restarting the game from an existing save in the maze
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs and breaking down equipment gave an abnormal amount of materials in the Lost Temple
[/olist]

[url=https://discord.gg/XbypJbQfxK]Got some questions or feedback for the game, you know where to find us![/url]

Safe adventures,
Kevin and the Gumballs team

notes.content:
[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395989/3e3ac63fcdf7ffb43bbc487058d18f8a45d78174.gif[/img]

Here's the big update you've all been waiting for! With the Elemental Gumballs reinforcing your team lineup and more patchfixes, let's dive into the changes that are happening for this patch!

[h2]v0.1.0 Patchnotes[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Added the Elemental Gumballs - Light Elemental, Dark Elemental, Air Elemental, Fire Elemental, Water Elemental, Earth Elemental, and Phoenix. You can acquire these familiar Gumballs with Hunting Certificates to recruit them!
[*] Changed the automatic pickup function to only take effect after perfectly clearing a floor
[*] Fixed an issue where the returning amount of floors from using the Entropy Ship in the Chaos Abyss was incorrect
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies defeated by the Annihilation skill was not correctly counted in the number of eliminations for the game manual of the Ultra Player Gumball
[*] Fixed an issue where the information of totems were incorrectly displayed when right clicking
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gumballs changed back to their original outfit when launching back into the game, instead of the outfit they were wearing (Gumballs have their drip again!)
[*] Fixed an issue where Pan Gu Gumball's skill was being triggered on every floor after returning to an earlier floor
[/olist]

[url=https://discord.gg/XbypJbQfxK]What's the most exciting thing you've seen? Come join in the action on our G&D Steam Community Discord![/url]

Safe adventures,
Kevin and the Gumballs team

notes.title: [Poll] Your voice, your vote! Determine your favourite old Gumball friends!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Adventurers,[/b]

You may have noticed that Gumballs & Dungeons has hit v0.0.1x! Yippee!!

Most of these have been bug fixes and resolutions of interactions, and we thank all our users for their patience and feedback as we work through these. Well, after bug fixes, what is next?

Of course, we want to see more of our old Gumball friends right? And that's the plan, with [b]v0.1 planned for the end of April![/b]

The question is, which Gumball friends do you want to see first?

That's right, we're opening voting so you can determine who's your best Gumball friend! (And who isn't invited to the party for now)

[h2]Vote now for the Gumball series![/h2]
